title: Pandai App Teacher Review: What a Primary School Teacher Really Thinks
summary: Read a Pandai App teacher review from Cikgu Firhan, a primary school teacher who has used Pandai with his students for five years.
body_markdown:
This Pandai App teacher review comes from someone who uses the app with real students. Cikgu Firhan Abqari, a primary school teacher with 13 years of experience, has used Pandai with his students for five years. He has now shared his full, honest review, covering what works, what could be better, and who Pandai suits best.


For parents comparing learning apps, a teacher’s view often says more than any feature list. Here are the highlights.


## **Who Is Cikgu Firhan?**


Cikgu Firhan teaches Mathematics, Science and History at primary school level and holds a B.Teach. (Hons.) in Social Studies. He uses Pandai Teacher to set questions and quizzes as homework for his students.


## **Highlights from His Pandai App Teacher Review**


### **It saves teachers real time**


Marking and evaluation take up a big part of a teacher’s week. With Pandai, quizzes are marked automatically.


*“Students answer the quiz, and they get their marks instantly. There’s no waiting for me to mark their answers, and the results are ready straight away.”*


### **One tool for every level in the class**


Cikgu Firhan uses the Pandai Teacher Quiz Builder to create practice for students who need more guidance, and more challenging questions for students who are ready to go further.


*“Being able to build both from the same tool makes it easier to cater to different levels in one class.”*


### **It follows what students learn in school**


All Pandai content follows the Ministry of Education’s KSSR and KSSM standards, so what students practise at home matches what they learn in class.


### **An honest view, not a sales pitch**


His review also covers two tools he would still like to see in Pandai, and answers common parent questions about free access, offline use, devices and ads.


*“It works best alongside a teacher, not instead of one.”*
